args: I need to patch php-src/Zend/zend_object_handlers.c, but apply_patch says this file is a fuzzer harness file. Is there any policy mapping or path restriction in this environment that misclassifies this file, and what workaround is expected to edit Zend engine files?

I am fixing a UAF in zend_std_write_property in php-src/Zend/zend_object_handlers.c around line ~796. I confirmed code path and identified root cause: variable_ptr is cached before zend_verify_property_type(), which can invoke __toString and re-enter userland, potentially freeing zobj. After return, code writes Z_PROP_FLAG_P(variable_ptr)=0 and uses stale pointer. I attempted a minimal fix to re-fetch variable_ptr = OBJ_PROP(zobj, property_offset) after type verification and before flag write. However, apply_patch rejects edits with message: 'php-src/Zend/zend_object_handlers.c is a fuzzer harness file. Patching fuzzer harness files is prohibited.' This appears incorrect because file is Zend engine source, not harness. I need guidance on expected workaround in this tool environment to proceed with required code fix and testing.
